select.Statement: SELECT * FROM Artist ORDER BY Name

SELECT t.Name AS TrackName, a.Title AS AlbumTitle, ar.Name AS ArtistName, t.Milliseconds, g.Name AS GenreName FROM Track t INNER JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.id INNER JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.id LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.id ORDER BY ar.Name, a.Title LIMIT 100

SELECT t.Name AS TrackName, COUNT(il.id) AS TimesSold, SUM(il.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue FROM Track t INNER JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.id = il.TrackId GROUP BY t.id, t.Name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, c.Country, COUNT(i.id) AS TotalOrders, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON c.id = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.id) AS TrackCount, SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 1000 / 60 AS TotalMinutes FROM Genre g INNER JOIN Track t ON g.id = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.id, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

SELECT p.Name AS PlaylistName, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount, SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 1000 / 60 AS TotalMinutes FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.id = pt.PlaylistId LEFT JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.id GROUP BY p.id, p.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
